name: ban
description: Bans the specified member from the guild for the reason and duration given.

name: deletewarn
description: Deletes a warn from a member by the specified id.

name: fixname
description: Changes the nickname of the specified member to a typable one.

name: getlogs
description: Gets all the logs or actions done on this user.

name: joinlock
description: Enables or disables the access of members from joining the guild.

name: kick
description: Kicks the specified member from the guild with the reason given.

name: kickpersist
description: Kicks the specified member for the duration and reason given even if the member rejoins the guild.

name: lock
description: Locks the specified or current channel with the reason given.

name: mute
description: Mutes the specified member forever or for the duration specified with the reason given.

name: nuke
description: Clones and deletes the specified channel with the reason given to remove all of its messages.

name: purge
description: Deletes the amount of messages given in the specified member.

name: rolepersist
description: Gives or removes the role given from the specified member even if the member rejoins the guild

name: slowmode
description: Sets the slowmode for the duration given in the specified or the current channel.

name: softban
description: Bans the specified member and unbans them with the reason given to remove their messages with the specified day limit.

name: timeleft
description: Gets the time left of the temp logs of the specified member.

name: unban
description: Unbans the specified member from the guild with the reason given.

name: unkickpersist
description: Unkickpersist the specified member with the reason given.

name: unlock
description: Unlocks the specified channel with the reason given.

name: unmute
description: Unmutes the specified member with the reason given.

name: warn
description: Warns the specified member with the reason given.

name: warnings
description: Gets the warnings of the specified user.
